meta_key_help.message: Append mode uses Shift together with your chosen copy modifier.

excluded_domains_help.message: Enter one domain per line. Excluded domains disable both hover previews and copy actions. Example: figma.com blocks figma.com and all of its subdomains.

preview_enabled_help.message: Show the dashed outline overlay while holding the copy modifier.

avoid_editable_help.message: Avoid contenteditable editors and rich text surfaces where copy gestures might be disruptive.

toast_duration_help.message: Controls how long the floating feedback remains visible.

settings_intro.message: Configure how copy gestures, hover previews, and safe-mode protections behave across websites.

popup_subtitle.message: Tweak the current site and the most-used interaction settings without opening the full options page.

popup_preview_hint.message: Show the target overlay while the modifier key is held.

popup_safe_hint.message: Avoid copying inside contenteditable editors and rich text surfaces.

popup_append_hint.message: Append mode stays available with Shift + modifier + Click.
